messages.en:
I gotta say, something's
missing in that letter you
sent. Oh, yeah! Muscle!
'Cause it was WEAK!
messages.et:
Pean ütlema, et su kirjast
on midagi puudu. Ah jaa!
LIHAST! Sest see oli
NÕRK!

messages.en:
What was up with that 
letter you sent me? Were
you trying to make me
feel dumb?
messages.et:
Mis lugu oli selle  
kirjaga, mille saatsid? Kas
sa üritasid mind rumalana
tunda panna?

messages.en:
I really didn't get that
poem you wrote me... It's
fine to be artsy, but
think about your reader!
messages.et:
Ma ei saanud tõesti aru
sellest luuletusest... On
okei olla kunstiline, aga
mõtle ka lugejale!
